audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Yone levels 3 and 4-5 and Poppy level 6, while the whys said 'Level 3 evens into a skill check', 'Levels 4-5 remain a skill check' and 'At 6 it's even'. Level 2 was marked Skill against a whys line reading 'Level 2 stays hers'. Four rows contradicted their own text.
audit.why: The packet chart (Poppy / Poppy / Skill / Skill / Skill / Yone / Yone) matches the prose exactly and matches a 50.06% win rate: Poppy owns the first two levels, the middle is a cooldown-reading contest, and Yone takes over from first item.
audit.corrected: Level 2 set to Poppy; level 3, levels 4-5 and level 6 set to Skill — matched full/content pairs with ratings and rewritten phases[].why lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: Steadfast Presence is the ability the entire page is built around and its cooldown appears nowhere; the same is true of Heroic Charge.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s — a 20s hole at rank 1 that shrinks to 12s, so the size of your window changes drastically across the lane. Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s.
audit.corrected: Both numbers written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0].text, phases[1].why, phases[2].why and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields told the player Steadfast Presence 'disables your E + Q3 dash' or negates the 'E-return'. Steadfast Presence stops DASHES. Soul Unbound is not a dash — Riot's text is a spirit leaving the body with bonus move speed, and the kit carries no dash flag on E. The abilities Poppy's W actually stops are Mortal Steel's second-stack dash and Fate Sealed's blink. Fate Sealed was also described as setting up knockups; it is a blink behind the last champion in a line plus a pull.
audit.why: Riot ability text in the brief; the mirror (poppy__yone) recorded the identical correction, so both directions now agree. Telling a Yone he cannot E out of Poppy's W removes the one escape that does work.
audit.corrected: Every 'disables your E' line rewritten to name the Q3 dash and Fate Sealed, with Soul Unbound explicitly stated as not a dash, and the grounding placed where Riot puts it — applied after a dash is stopped.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hammer Shock carries a grounding flag in the kit file that Riot's description does not support — it deals damage and creates a slowing zone that explodes. The only grounding in the kit follows a dash stopped by Steadfast Presence.
audit.why: Where a derived flag contradicts the description, the description wins.
audit.corrected: No grounding written on the Q; grounding attributed to the W-stops-dash case only.

edits.before: W shield-grit covers every exchange you start. Only take the trade when Poppy's Steadfast Presence is down.
edits.after: Heroic Charge threatens a wall stun on 14s, and her W eats the dash you would answer with. Don't approach.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Poppy must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online for both. Steadfast Presence is 20s at rank 1 — that downtime is when your pattern actually works.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Steadfast Presence's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even window: her W falls to 14-16s while Heroic Charge hits 11-12s, so trade only when one of them is spent and farm otherwise.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Poppy's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind her and pulls, it is not a knockup — and her W can stop that blink. Keeper's Verdict channels first.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Poppy carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind their back line and pulls it to you — build your teamfight around that. Poppy carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.before: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — Grounds you — disables your E + Q3 dash. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — stops the Q3 dash and Fate Sealed on 12-20s, grounding you after. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Grounds you — disables your E + Q3 dash. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops dashes on 12-20s — your Q3 and R, not Soul Unbound.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Steadfast Presence: Grounds you — disables your E + Q3 dash. When it is down — Q3-R her.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops the Q3 dash and Fate Sealed, and grounds you after — Soul Unbound is no dash.

edits.before: Poppy punishes your dashes — her W (Steadfast Presence) stops your Q3 dash and E-return and can ground you, while her E (Heroic Charge) stuns you into a wall; don't dash at her when W is up and pick trades around that cooldown.
edits.after: Poppy punishes your dashes — Steadfast Presence (W) stops the Q3 dash and Fate Sealed on 12-20s and grounds you after, while Heroic Charge (E) stuns you into a wall on 10-14s; Soul Unbound is not a dash, so it still gets you out.

edits.before: Poppy wins levels 1-2 — her Steadfast Presence hard-counters your dash-heavy kit, negating your Q3 and E-return, and her E can stun you into terrain for a punishing trade. Play around her W: don't engage while it's up and farm patiently.
edits.after: Poppy wins levels 1-2 — Steadfast Presence hard-counters your dashes, eating the Q3 cast and Fate Sealed, though not Soul Unbound, and Heroic Charge can stun you into terrain. Play around her W: don't engage while it is up and farm patiently.

edits.before: Avoid dashing into her Steadfast Presence — it eats your mobility
edits.after: Never spend the Q3 dash or Fate Sealed while Steadfast Presence is up

notes: The page said in five places that Steadfast Presence disables Yone's E. It does not — Soul Unbound is a spirit leaving the body, not a dash, and Riot's W text stops dashes specifically. What Poppy's W actually eats is Mortal Steel's second-stack dash and Fate Sealed's blink. That correction matches the already-audited mirror. Hammer Shock's grounding flag is a tooltip-parse misfire.
